info.name: INNODIGYM Power (unofficial)
info.description: Built from route and field names found in the Android app (v0.1.0). HTTP methods, parameters and bodies are mostly GUESSES. Verify each against real responses. Use only with your own account.

request.description: CONFIRMED (captured from live app traffic). Field is `accountVal`, accountType=2 is email login.

CONFIRMED: send only ONE field per request, not the full profile — a combined/full-object update 500s. Also confirmed: height, weight, and trainingConsume 500 no matter what's sent, any type, any value — a genuine upstream bug, not a client-side formatting issue. Every other field (nickName, birthday, sex, unit, trainingTime, targetWeight) works fine sent alone.
CONFIRMED: all-time totals {totalDuration(s),totalConsume(kcal),totalCapacity(tenths of kg),totalDistance,coins}.
Permanently deletes the account. Do not send.
Parameter name is a guess.
CONFIRMED.
CONFIRMED. Returns the full editable object incl. mainStepList with count (reps), sideWeight (weight), restTime, groupNum (sets) per step. Use this response as the base for Save.

request.description: CONFIRMED WORKING, but it needs the FULL object, not a trimmed one — this is the exact cause of a 500 if you send a shorthand. Workflow: 1) GET Detail for the course you want to edit. 2) Copy its entire `data` object verbatim. 3) Paste it here as the body, replacing this example. 4) Only then change the fields you actually want (name, mainStepList[].count=reps, .sideWeight=weight, .restTime, .groupNum=sets). 5) Send. Do not drop any fields the Detail response included, even ones that look cosmetic — the body below is a real captured example (course 2266) showing every field the server expects. To CREATE a new program instead of updating: omit `id`, `courseNo`, and every step's `id`/`courseId` from the body — confirmed working. The response gives no new id back; look it up via List afterward (matching by name is the practical approach).
CONFIRMED: method is POST, not DELETE (the DELETE verb itself returns a 500 'Request method not supported').

Returns the FULL action library (268 entries, both built-in and custom), not just your own custom ones — filter client-side on `custom: true`. Note: newly-created custom actions have been observed NOT appearing here even after refresh — an upstream quirk, not necessarily a client bug.
No update route was found in the app.
CONFIRMED: method is POST, not DELETE, same pattern as course deletion.
CONFIRMED. curTime ('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') is REQUIRED, else opaque 500. Full plan objects incl. planItemMap. Only one ongoing plan allowed at a time.
CONFIRMED. curTime required. Stopped + ended plans, summary fields only (use Get for details).
CONFIRMED. Param is planId (not id). data null if unknown.

CONFIRMED. Create; add "id" to update in place (send whole object; stopped plans -> plan_status_error). courseId = official OR custom course id (resp custom 0/1). planItemMap keys must equal trainDays. Returns data:null. One ongoing plan at a time (plan_already_exist_ongoing). See docs/plan-api.md.
CONFIRMED. Status -> 3; moves to stopped list.
CONFIRMED. Hard delete, idempotent.
WARNING: despite the name this CREATES and persists an auto-generated plan (returns it). Delete afterwards.
CONFIRMED. startTime/endTime (yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss) bound the workouts returned; size is the page size. Returns summary rows only (extData is null here).

CONFIRMED. The parameter is recordId (the sportRecordId from the list). Using id= returns a generic 'system error'. Returns the summary plus extData: one item per exercise (actionId, actionName, actionNo, picUrl, actionType, sort, powerMode, modeParam, weight, count, duration).

CONFIRMED: record fields plus extData[] one row per set {actionId,actionName,actionNo,picUrl,sort,weight(tenths of kg),count,duration(s)}. coreData is tenths of kg (65720 = 6572.0 kg).

CONFIRMED. Creates an EMPTY workout shell and returns its id in data. Start time is sportTime (NOT startTime). Shell has duration 0 and is not shown in the list until upload fills it in. Required: sportMode, sportModeId, deviceType, deviceCode, sportTime. Validation messages arrive one at a time, in no fixed order.

PARTLY CONFIRMED. Fills in a shell from Create. Required: sportRecordId, coreData, duration, consume. capacity and coins are accepted and stored. Works once per record ('请勿重复上传' = do not upload twice). extData (per-exercise items) is NOT solved: null or '' succeed, but every list, object and JSON-string form tried returns a generic system error, so per-exercise detail cannot be written yet. Unknown keys are silently ignored; steps must be an integer.
CONFIRMED: POST (not DELETE). Removes the record from the list, but account totals (/app/statistics) are cumulative and are NOT reduced.

CONFIRMED 2026-10-29: query statisticsType is a Java enum, only 1 (daily) and 2 (monthly) are valid; 0/3/4 give a conversion error, omitting it gives 'type required'. Optional startTime/endTime=YYYY-MM-DD (without dates: everything). Type 1 -> data.dailyList[] {sportDate,targetDuration(s),targetConsume(kcal),realDuration(s),realConsume(kcal),realCapacity(tenths of kg),realDistance}; days without workouts are absent; monthList null. Type 2 -> data.monthList[] {yearMonth:'202610',totalDuration,totalConsume,totalCapacity,totalDistance}; dailyList null. Both: top-level totalDuration/totalConsume/totalCapacity/totalDistance; empty range -> zeros and null lists. Server stats can differ from sport/record/list.

CONFIRMED: data.latestBadges[] and data.allBadges[9]: {id,type,target,activePic,inactivePic,receiveTime:'2026/10/27'|null,received}. type 1 = Consume (kcal 1000/3000/10000), 2 = Duration (min 100/300/1000), 3 = Volume (kg 5000/20000/50000).
